C1516.title: FBI Chicago PSA on 764, a Violent Online Group
C1516.summary: The FBI issued a public service announcement warning about an online group known as 764, whose members coerce and manipulate minors over the internet into committing acts of self-harm and other extreme behaviors, highlighting severe virtual violence and psychological control that causes real trauma.
